// tag::body[]
Use a Google Cloud Storage bucket as a cache.

This cache implements the `add` operation as an existence check followed by a separate upload, so the operation is not atomic and concurrent writers can both succeed. Therefore, this cache is not suitable for deduplication.
// end::body[]
